soil.interpretation: homogeneous research archetype, not a BOFEK-ID profile or field calibration

initial_state.pulse: initial far-column physical storage perturbation; no meteorological or well source in coupled model

mass.storage: committed water content times dz plus ponding

coupling.driver: explicit research registry/context; existing production ABI and service
coupling.predictor_metadata: qbot=-0.001 cm/day, inverse slope=-100 day; predictor only, not physical flux or storage

failure_policy: Record actual failed stage, return code and unchanged revisions; no tolerance widening or artificial sources
scope_ceiling: one accepted window / negative result, no transient Hupsel, restart or production admission
